name: website-cloner
description: Clone a live web page into an editable codebase with measured fidelity: Playwright scripts extract computed styles, authored CSS, assets, motion and interaction evidence; specs are generated per section; the model builds; pixelmatch and structural gates prove the result. Runs headless by default, or through the user's armed Firefox tab (Browser Tunnel) for logged-in pages. Skill: clone-website. Agents: extractor, builder, comparator.
